question: Silicosis, caused by inhalation of free crystalline silica dust, is the most prevalent pneumoconiosis worldwide and characteristically produces upper-lobe nodular fibrosis.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is actually true. Silicosis IS the most prevalent pneumoconiosis. Its nodular upper-lobe fibrosis pattern on chest X-ray is distinct from the lower-lobe fibrosis of asbestosis.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Silicosis is the commonest pneumoconiosis globally; it affects quarry workers, stonemasons, and sandblasters. The fibrotic nodules preferentially affect the upper lobes, unlike asbestosis which causes lower-lobe fibrosis.
